findings.evidence: template/scripts/openspec_lifecycle.py:539–540 and template/scripts/execute_requirement.py:283–286 pass read_platform_config output to lifecycle_mode. That reader merges arbitrary external operator keys over project keys at template/scripts/_platform_common.py:234–240, including platform_version and the supported-combination fields. A read-only reproduction with committed platform_version="1.0.0", operator.enabled=true, and external platform_version="source" selected "coordinator". Conversely, an external downstream version can mask an unsupported source combination. This contradicts the active completion-lifecycle requirement that the committed .dev-platform.toml determines the mode and unsupported source combinations never switch paths.
findings.summary: Lifecycle selection uses operator-overlaid configuration rather than the committed project contract, allowing a downstream checkout to select coordinator behavior.
